clue.text: Firm assembling train sets

indicators.note: assembling puts parts together in a new order, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A company that builds model railway sets.
explanation.walkthrough: 'assembling' rearranges the letters of TRAIN SETS.
explanation.definitionFit: Firm and resistant are synonyms when describing something that does not give way under pressure.

clue.text: One may get in the way when rushed

indicators.note: get in means one piece goes inside another

parts.note: RD is the abbreviation for road, a way
an ace is a one in cards

explanation.surface: Someone who blocks the road when in a hurry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'One' suggests I, but here it is ACE, the one in a pack of cards.
explanation.definitionFit: Raced is the past tense of race, meaning hurried or rushed.

clue.text: Produce notes about sailboat drawing

indicators.note: about means one piece surrounds the other

parts.note: to sing is to produce musical notes
a ketch is a two-masted sailing boat

explanation.surface: Writing notes while making a picture of a sailing boat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'notes' suggests writing, but here they are musical.
explanation.definitionFit: Sketching is a form of drawing, quick rough work in pencil.

clue.text: Break apart — noise is dreadful

indicators.note: dreadful means in a terrible state, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A dreadful noise made as something splits apart.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dreadful' rearranges APART and NOISE; 'is' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: A break between two people or things is a parting, a split.

clue.text: He'll judge a section about right with little hesitation

indicators.note: about means one piece goes around another

parts.note: a bit is a section, so a section gives a bit
er is a short sound of hesitation

explanation.surface: A judge weighing part of a case concerning rights, with a slight pause.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' puts R inside A BIT to make ARBIT.
explanation.definitionFit: An arbiter is someone appointed to judge a dispute.

clue.text: Not cosy (not usually, that is) for business magnates

indicators.note: not usually suggests an unusual order of the letters

explanation.surface: Wealthy tycoons who are not normally cosy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not usually' rearranges NOT COSY; 'that is' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Tycoons are wealthy and powerful business leaders.

clue.text: Play the lawyer in America without impact

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so one piece surrounds the other

parts.note: DA is a District Attorney, a US prosecuting lawyer
to ram is to strike with force, an impact

explanation.surface: An American attorney's courtroom performance that lacks punch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' is used in its old sense of outside, not lacking; DA is the US term for a public prosecutor.
explanation.definitionFit: A play is a stage work, and drama is the general word for such theatrical pieces.

clue.text: Avoid such coarse stuff

definitions.meaning: a heavy, coarse cotton or linen fabric

explanation.surface: Steer clear of rough material.
explanation.walkthrough: 'such' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Duck is to dodge or avoid, and also a strong close-woven fabric used for sails and work clothes.

clue.text: A cheat in the matter of love

parts.note: to do someone is to cheat them
re means concerning, in the matter of

explanation.surface: A swindler involved in a love affair.
explanation.definitionFit: To adore someone is to love them deeply.

clue.text: Scattered and set about a woman's fans

indicators.note: about means one piece surrounds another
scattered letters are spread out and rearranged

parts.note: her is the possessive for a woman

explanation.surface: A woman's fans scattered and settled around her.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Scattered' rearranges AND SET, and 'about' wraps those letters round HER.
explanation.definitionFit: Adherents are followers or supporters, as fans are.

clue.text: Make many a pile, being economical

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, so it stands for many
a heap is a pile

explanation.surface: Earning a fortune by being thrifty.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Make' and 'being' are link words; C = 100 is a standard crossword way to clue 'many'.
explanation.definitionFit: Something economical costs little, and low cost is exactly what cheap means.

clue.text: Maintain ministers should set the scene

parts.note: to back someone is to support or maintain them
the cloth is a collective term for the clergy

explanation.surface: A call for the clergy to set the scene.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The cloth' is a collective term for clergy, after their clerical garb.
explanation.definitionFit: A backcloth is the painted curtain at the back of a stage, giving the scenery for a play.

clue.text: Order given with a flourish

definitions.meaning: an order of chivalry is an honour, a medal or insignia awarded
an ornamental flourish is an embellishment

explanation.surface: An instruction delivered with a showy gesture.
explanation.definitionFit: An order such as the OBE is an honour pinned on, and a flourish is ornamentation; both are senses of adornment.

clue.text: Time the old car fails to start

parts.note: ye is an archaic form of the

indicators.note: a car that fails to start loses its first letter here

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: The moment an old motor car will not start.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fails to start' removes the first letter of CAR, leaving AR.
explanation.definitionFit: A year is a period of time, twelve months long.

clue.text: Just the instrument for great sound!

definitions.text: Just the instrument for great sound!

parts.words: Just the instrument for great sound!
parts.note: praise for a fine musical instrument, but read as a device that turns small sound into great sound

explanation.surface: Praise for a musical instrument with a rich tone.
explanation.definitionFit: A microphone picks up small sounds so they can be amplified loudly.

clue.text: Person who's discharged for always carrying a hand-warmer

indicators.note: carrying means one piece holds another inside it

parts.note: e'er is a poetic contraction of ever, meaning always
a mitt is a mitten, which keeps a hand warm

explanation.surface: Someone released from hospital who always carries a mitten.
explanation.walkthrough: 'carrying' does the containing. 'Discharged' suggests someone released from hospital or the army; read it as someone who gives something off.
explanation.definitionFit: An emitter is something or someone that gives off or discharges a substance or signal.

clue.text: Winning over the listener in the finish

indicators.note: in means one piece goes inside another

parts.note: an ending is a finish
the ear is the organ of listening

explanation.surface: Persuading the audience at the end.
explanation.walkthrough: 'over' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: A winning smile is charming, which is what endearing means.

clue.text: Take issue about heel getting the cheese

indicators.note: about means one piece goes around the other

parts.note: issue means offspring, such as a son
a ship heels when it leans over, or tilts

explanation.surface: Arguing about a shoe heel before getting cheese.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heel' looks like part of a shoe, but it is the nautical verb: to heel is to tilt. 'Take' and 'getting' are link words.
explanation.definitionFit: Stilton is a famous English blue cheese named after a village in Cambridgeshire.

clue.text: The handling of someone who is patient?

definitions.text: The handling of someone who is patient?

parts.words: The handling of someone who is patient?
parts.note: patient looks like an adjective for someone calm, but it is the noun, a person under medical care

explanation.surface: How to deal with someone who is calm and tolerant.
explanation.definitionFit: Medical care given to a patient is called their treatment.

clue.text: A tree with bark?

parts.note: every tree has bark, but the question mark asks for one whose name suggests a barking animal

explanation.surface: A simple question about a tree's outer layer.
explanation.definitionFit: The dogwood is a shrub or small tree of the genus Cornus, whose name contains a barking animal.

clue.text: Head of state to be seen in due course

indicators.note: to be seen in means one piece appears inside another

parts.note: one's deserts are what one is due

indicators.note: head of means the first letter

explanation.surface: A head of state who will appear in time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in due course' looks like a phrase, but 'course' is the definition: a course of a meal. 'Just deserts' is what someone is due.
explanation.definitionFit: Dessert is the sweet course served at the end of a meal.

clue.text: A pound in rises negotiated — or close

indicators.note: in means one piece goes inside another
negotiated suggests something worked out and rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
L is the abbreviation for pound, from Latin libra

explanation.surface: A pay rise including a pound is close to agreed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts L inside RISES, and 'negotiated' rearranges those letters into IRLESS after A.
explanation.definitionFit: Close weather or a close room is stuffy, lacking fresh air.

clue.text: Article on superior, though wrong-doing, supporter

parts.note: a is the indefinite article
better means superior

explanation.surface: A grammatical article about a superior who supports wrong.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on' is a link word placing A before BETTER.
explanation.definitionFit: An abetter is someone who helps another commit a crime, a supporter of wrongdoing.

clue.text: Man taking part had a magnificent physique

indicators.note: taking part signals that the answer is a part of the following words

explanation.surface: A man who had a fine physique.
explanation.walkthrough: 'taking part' points to letters within hAD A Magnificent.
explanation.definitionFit: Adam is the first man in the Bible, and his name is a Hebrew word for man.

clue.text: Middle Eastern flower

indicators.note: the middle of a word means all but its first and last letters

explanation.surface: A bloom from the Middle East.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Middle Eastern' looks like a region, but it means the middle of the word Eastern.
explanation.definitionFit: An aster is a daisy-like flower, often purple.

clue.text: Those manipulating others to their own advantage

definitions.text: Those manipulating others to their own advantage

parts.words: Those manipulating others to their own advantage
parts.note: sounds like exploiters, but read their own advantage as the patients' benefit and manipulation as hands-on treatment

explanation.surface: People who exploit others for their own gain.
explanation.definitionFit: Osteopaths treat patients by manipulating bones and muscles, for the patients' benefit.

clue.text: The Spaniard presenting oriental coppers with gold

parts.note: the sen is a small Japanese coin, a copper from the Orient
or is gold in heraldry

explanation.surface: A Spaniard handing over Asian coins with gold.
explanation.definitionFit: Senor is the Spanish title for a man, so it stands for a Spaniard.

clue.text: Mismanaged raid — quite fruitless

indicators.note: mismanaged means badly arranged, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A badly run raid that got nothing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mismanaged' rearranges RAID.
explanation.definitionFit: Arid land is so dry that it bears nothing, so it is barren or fruitless.

clue.text: Lay to rest party split

parts.note: to inter is to bury, lay to rest
a sect is a faction or party

explanation.surface: Burying a political party that has split.
explanation.definitionFit: Lines that intersect cut across each other, dividing the space, so split works as a loose synonym.

clue.text: The deep canoe needs to be properly shaped

indicators.note: shaping the word properly means rearranging its letters

explanation.surface: A canoe built to cope with deep water.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to be properly shaped' rearranges CANOE.
explanation.definitionFit: The deep is a poetic name for the sea, the open ocean.

clue.text: Blush when attacked in beastly fashion

definitions.meaning: to blush is to ... in the face, read as two words
pierced by an animal's horns or tusks, as by a bull

explanation.surface: Turning red after an assault by an animal.
explanation.definitionFit: A bull or boar that attacks with horns or tusks has pierced its victim; split in two, the word is going red.

clue.text: A trying individual of a certain eminence — a counsellor

parts.note: a tor is a rocky hill, an eminence, especially on Dartmoor
a mentor is a trusted adviser or counsellor

explanation.surface: A tiresome dignitary acting as an adviser.
explanation.walkthrough: A TOR is a craggy hilltop, a word common in the south-west of England.
explanation.definitionFit: A tormentor tries the patience of others, so is a trying person.
